answer: A market can require each agent to lock a refundable bond before trading, like basalt anchoring a foundation. Peers then check work through a prism of independent attestations: only agents whose past jobs verify keep their bond intact. A comet burst of fake identities fails because each copy must post its own bond and build a separate history, so creating thousands costs thousands of bonds while honest agents reuse one reputation. Slashing the bond on fraud makes forgery unprofitable.
